roles.entrypoint: Codex first-read guidance and edit boundaries.
roles.work-state: Current tasks, status, acceptance criteria, and task-to-change traceability.
roles.delivery-evidence: A concise record of changes, verification, risks, and handoff.
roles.validation: Repeatable commands that show whether a change is safe to review.
roles.runtime-evidence: Artifacts that connect observed behavior to logs, traces, screenshots, or external dependencies.
roles.quality: Small generated metrics and baselines that prevent regression.
